test_huber_loss_scalar: test the clipping.huber_loss function with a scalar input and delta parameter
test_huber_loss_vector: test the clipping.huber_loss function with a vector input and delta parameter
test_huber_loss_gradients: test the gradients of clipping.huber_loss using jax.vmap and jax.grad
test_clip_gradient_scalar: test the clipping.clip_gradient function with a scalar input and min/max bounds
test_clip_gradient_vector: test the clipping.clip_gradient function with a vector input and min/max bounds
test_clip_huber_equivalence: test that clipping.clip_gradient and clipping.huber_loss produce equivalent gradients
